findings.passage: House Bill 1334 simply puts this requirement into effect by requiring proof of United States citizenship in order to complete the voter registration process.
findings.note: Press release in his name on his bill HB 1334. The release says the bill would require a person to show citizenship before registration is complete, lists ways to show it, makes birth certificate copies free, and has state and county election offices try to find the proof for applicants who lack it.

findings.passage: To address that issue, I am co-sponsoring House Bill 1596, legislation creating a constitutional amendment allowing The People to vote on whether Pennsylvania should have Voter ID.
findings.note: Same release: he says he co-sponsors HB 1596, a constitutional amendment to let voters decide on a voter ID requirement. He says his citizenship bill would not reach people already registered.

findings.passage: When the state registers illegal immigrants to vote in U.S. elections and then spends four years in court at taxpayer expense trying to cover it up instead of being forthright suggests to me that a computer ‘glitch’ may not explain the totality of what is going on here,
findings.note: Quoted by the Pennsylvania Daily Star (from a statement of his) after a court ruling on records of non-citizens registered to vote. The story says he backs his SAFE Act (proof of citizenship to register) and a constitutional amendment requiring ID to vote.
